questions.q:
23. In a panchayat election Candidate A secured 30% of the total votes and did NOT qualify by 6 votes. Candidate B secured 40% of the total votes and got 6 votes more than the bare minimum to qualify. The total number of votes were _________.

SSC CHSL 10/06/2022 (Afternoon)
questions.s:
23.(d)

Let the total number of votes be 100y.

According to the question,

40% of 100y - 6 = 30% of 100y + 6

40% of 100y - 30% of 100y = 6 + 6

40y - 30y = 12

10y = 12

So, total number of votes = 100y = 100(1.2) = 120 votes

questions.q:
In a school, 30% are boys and rest are girls. If 60% of boys and 80% of girls are present on a certain day, then find the percentage of students absent on that day.

एक स्कूल में 30% लड़के हैं और शेष लड़कियाँ हैं। यदि किसी निश्चित दिन 60% लड़के और 80% लड़कियाँ उपस्थित हैं, तो उस दिन अनुपस्थित छात्रों का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Let the number of students in the school = 100

Number of boys in the school = 30

Number of girls in the school = 70

Total number of absent students = (100 - 60)% of 30 + (100 - 80)% of 70

= 12 + 14

= 26

Hence, percentage of students absent on that day = 26%

Then increase in population = 18000 × 5% = 900
But the actual growth in population = 19200 - 18000 = 1200
This is because , female population increase by 2% extra

Female population = 15000 and male = 3000
Required ratio = male : female = 1 : 5

questions.s:
Total questions he need to answer correctly = 75 x 0.8 = 60

He answers 0.75x40 = 30 correct out of first 40.

So he must answer 30 correct out of the remaining 35

Required % = 30/35 x 100 = 85.71% = 86%

questions_hin.q_hi: At a recruitment test, the candidates were tested for General Awareness {GA} and Quantitative Techniques {QT}. 54% and 45% failed in GA and QT, respectively, while 16% failed in both. If 136 candidates passed in both, what was the total number of candidates?
o_hi:
800

    640

    600    

    850
800
questions_hin.s_hi:
Solution
Students passed in both = 100-[54+45-16] =17
Pass in both = 17
As per question,
17→136
100→800

questions_hin.q_hi:
A man’s annual income has increased by Rs.3 lakhs but the tax on income that he has to pay has reduced from 20% to 16%. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his intial income (in Rs lakhs)?
एक आदमी की वार्षिक आय में रु 3 लाख की वृद्धि हुई है, लेकिन उसके द्वारा दी जाने वाली आय पर कर 20% से घटकर 16% हो गया है। वह अब पहले की तरह कर का भुगतान करता है। उसकी आय (रु लाख में) कितनी थी?
14. एक छात्र को मनोविज्ञान में उत्तीर्ण होने के लिए 20% अंक चाहिए। उसे 10% अंक प्राप्त हुए और वह 20 अंकों से अनुत्तीर्ण हो गया। उत्तीर्ण होने के लिए कितने अंक चाहिए ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
14.(a) छात्र ने 10% अंक प्राप्त किए और 20 अंकों से अनुत्तीर्ण हो गया।

⇒(20% - 10%)= 10%, 20 अंकों के बराबर है।

तो, उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत = 20% = 2010×20=40 अंक

अर्थात, उत्तीर्ण अंक 40 है।

questions_hin.q_hi:
In a test consisting of 75 questions carrying one mark each, Samir answered 75% of the first 40 questions correctly. What approximate percent of the other 35 questions does he need to answer correctly to score 80% in the entire test?

किसी परीक्षा में एक अंक वाले 75 प्रश्न थे। समीर ने पहले 40 प्रश्नों में से 75% प्रश्नों का सही उत्तर दिया। संपूर्ण परीक्षा में 80% अंक प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे अन्य 35 प्रश्नों में से लगभग कितने प्रतिशत प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर देने की आवश्यकता है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Total questions he need to answer correctly = 75 x 0.8 = 60

He answers 0.75x40 = 30 correct out of first 40.

So he must answer 30 correct out of the remaining 35

Required % = 30/35 x 100 = 85.71% = 86%

questions_hin.q_hi: 4. दो वर्ष पहले, एक शहर की जनसंख्या 5,00,000 थी। यदि वार्षिक जन्म दर और वार्षिक मृत्यु दर क्रमशः 6% और 3% है, तो शहर की वर्तमान जनसंख्या कितनी है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
4.(c)

वार्षिक वृद्धि दर =(6-3)= 3%

2 वर्षों के लिए प्रभावी विकास दर =

3 + 3 +3×3100 = 6.09%

वर्तमान जनसंख्या = 5,00,000 ×106.09%

= 530450
